name: vermillionaurora-catalog
description: Static website for Vermillion Aurora Productions, with an art portfolio, commission/contact interface, and the Neural Dance interactive demo.

scripts.build: node payments/build-checkout-catalog.mjs && astro build && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/catalog.test.mjs cloudflare/paypal-inventory.test.mjs cloudflare/paypal-orders.test.mjs cloudflare/checkout-recovery.test.mjs cloudflare/checkout-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node tests/catalog.browser-test.mjs && node payments/paypal-checkout.browser-test.cjs && node payments/bitcoin-checkout.browser-test.cjs && node tests/cart.browser-test.mjs
